title: Chapter 389 Crocodile Leader Lapachi
content:
Chapter 389 Crocodile Leader Lapachi

Not long after, the barrier of the Great Wall of Steel finally disappeared.

Wang Shuo immediately led the army and rushed towards the Great Wall.

The Great Wall must be occupied as quickly as possible. If the enemy on the opposite side also launched an attack at the same time, a fierce battle would be encountered immediately.

Walking on the passage leading to the Great Wall.

A desolate breath instantly hit me.

This Great Wall seemed to have stood here for countless years and experienced countless wars.

Warriors of various races fought hard here.

The height of the Great Wall is 30 meters, and in some dangerous places, it can even reach 50 meters.

Each wall brick is a boulder that is stronger than the silver-level wall bricks, and it is completely incomparable to ordinary granite and other hard rocks.

Moreover, Wang Shuo also found some traces of repairs with silver wall bricks and even gold wall bricks.

When he came to the wall, Wang Shuo's hanging heart was finally put down temporarily.

Because the enemy on the opposite side did not appear, there was a barrier 30 meters outside the city wall, as if protecting the entire Great Wall.

Wang Shuo frowned. It was obvious that Lord Zach wanted his side to climb the city wall first.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but become more worried. Could it be that the other side climbed the city wall first, or started a battle for the city wall, which meant that Dahuai Territory had no chance at all?

Wang Shuo rode on Dahuang and inspected the soldiers' defense arrangements on the Great Wall, which was at least 20 meters wide.

The entire Great Wall is nearly 500 kilometers long, and the undead defend half of it.

Ten human armies, each army also needs to defend about 25 kilometers.

Wang Shuo divided the 150,000 people of the Seventh Army, which he was responsible for, into 15 columns.

Take turns to defend the city wall.

Among them, in some dangerous places, there is a deep depression under the Great Wall, and the enemy has no way to climb up.

So, in fact, the Seventh Army only has a few key places that need to be defended.

At each defense point, 10,000 people were stationed, another 10,000 were on standby, and there were 10,000 reserve troops stationed further away to take charge of logistics.

The 150,000-man army was divided into five groups.

Wang Shuo personally selected a position that was most vulnerable to the enemy's attack and stationed there.

This section of the wall had a plain in front, which was extremely conducive to the charge of a large-scale army group.

There was a beacon tower every 1 kilometer on the Great Wall.

In the fierce battle, the commanders could not help but fail to notice the messages sent by others.

The beacon tower could still play a huge role at critical moments.

Wang Shuo also temporarily built a large number of arrow towers on the wall to facilitate archers to shoot.

At the same time, a large number of catapults and bronze crossbow carts were placed in the rear.

Almost 2,000 soldiers from the crossbow battalion were stationed here.

After everything was ready, Wang Shuo sat cross-legged on the battlement of the city wall, looking at the sunset in the distance, quietly waiting for the enemy outside the barrier.

The setting sun was like blood, shining on the long wall that was winding like a dragon, adding a bit of desolation.

And outside the barrier, a few kilometers away.

There were also two forces stationed.

They were clearly divided from each other. One side was the Wagliang Empire established by monsters. The commander in charge of this attack was the chief of Crocodile Ridge, Lapachi.

In addition to the crocodile tribe, there were also the Toad Tribe, the Wild Lion Tribe, the Goshawk Tribe, and other major tribes of the monster tribe.

They were ordered by the Monster King to attack the new trial space this time, and they must take it down to expand the territory for the empire.

Except for a head, Lapachi's body was no different from that of a human.

It can be said that he was a mutant with a crocodile head, and of course, he also had a sexy crocodile tail.
